title: Q2 2026 Cash Flow Surge & Record $1.7B M&A Deployment Confirm Anti-Mr. Market Buy Signal
trigger_reason: International Corporate Wire: Constellation Software Inc. Announces Results for Q2 2026 and Record M&A Deployment
what_was_before: Q2 2026 pre-call preview highlighted FCFA2S up 57% YoY to $345M and OCF up 10% to $477M, offset by organic growth slowing to 3% due to Altera comp distortions. Intrinsic fair value was $2,880.00.
what_changes_now: Post-earnings transcript audit and financial review confirm that the organic deceleration (1% FX-adjusted) was driven by transient accounting comps (Altera $17M upfront 2025 revenue, TDC comp, and South American customer exit) rather than GenAI disintermediation. FCFA2S surged 57% YoY to $345M and M&A deployment reached a record $1.7B YTD ($893M in Q2 + $818M post-quarter). We raise Intrinsic Fair Value to $2,950.00 and maintain High Conviction BUY.

title: Vistry Swings to H1 Loss as Inventory Liquidation Spikes Daily Debt; Strategic Review & September SAHP Grants Mark High-Stakes Pivot
trigger_reason: International Corporate Wire: Vistry Group Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
what_was_before: Vistry Group is undergoing a critical operational repositioning away from traditional private speculative housebuilding toward a capital-light Partnerships housing model. While heavy tactical discounting on unsold open-market stock pushed H1 2026 into a £30M pre-tax loss, aggressive land de-stocking and partner-funded completions under the UK's £39B Social and Affordable Housing Programme are targeted to restore net cash by year-end.
what_changes_now: Vistry's H1 2026 trading update revealed an expected statutory loss before tax of ~$39M USD (£30M) following a ~$65M USD (£50M) adverse impact from heavy private sales discounting (7.1% vs 1.4% YoY) and site write-downs. Average daily net debt expanded to ~$1.04B USD (£799M) as land creditors were cleared and suppliers paid faster, while CFO Tim Lawlor unexpectedly resigned ahead of the pivotal September 24 strategic review. We maintain a cautious stance until SAHP grant flows and CEO review details are released.

title: UPWK Q2 2026 Audit: Revenue Guidance Trim Triggers Deep Value Buy Opportunity at $8.61
trigger_reason: Q2 2026 Post-Market Earnings Audit: Full Operational & Guidance Review
what_was_before: Upwork reported Q2 2026 revenue of $191.7M (-2% YoY) and record Adjusted EBITDA of $64.1M (33.4% margin), but trimmed full-year revenue guidance to $730M-$750M due to Google SEO search disruption and low-complexity task erosion from AI automation.
what_changes_now: Upwork's Q2 2026 earnings report confirmed a top-line guidance trim to $730M-$750M due to headwinds from Google SEO search updates and AI automation of lower-complexity tasks. However, the market's post-earnings drop to $8.61 creates an asymmetric deep-value buy zone. Operating profitability hit record highs with Q2 Adjusted EBITDA of $64.1M (33.4% margin), supported by a 20%+ workforce restructuring that will generate $70M in annualized OpEx savings. Management continues to aggressively retire shares—deploying $109.7M in H1 2026 alone—backed by $241.2M in net cash ($1.83/share). We upgrade our action signal to BUY with an updated Base Case Intrinsic Fair Value of $12.50 per share.
